hypotheses.S1_hard_performance_is_stable: Across three fits, hard-router mean KL has coefficient of variation at most 10% on every corpus.
hypotheses.S2_expert_union_is_stable: Every restart's full expert union has mean canonical cosine at least 0.90 with the primary union.
hypotheses.S3_matched_expert_subspaces_are_stable: After optimal permutation, mean tail-subspace canonical cosine is at least 0.70 for every restart.
hypotheses.S4_hard_routes_are_stable: After expert alignment, hard route agreement with the primary fit is at least 70% on every corpus and restart.
hypotheses.S5_top2_route_sets_are_stable: After expert alignment, mean top-two set Jaccard with the primary fit is at least 0.70 on every corpus and restart.
hypotheses.S6_contextual_gain_replicates: Every seed has lower hard-router mean KL than fixed rank 20 on every corpus.
hypotheses.S7_fixed68_gap_replicates: Every seed has at least 10% higher hard-router mean KL than fixed rank 68 on every corpus.
